thesis: Discovery is staged compatibility under private changing constraints rather than static similarity.
role: Define coordination cost and the intent object.

ideas.statement: Matching needs capability, current intention, constraint fit, evidence and relational viability, revealed progressively.
Cheap sending externalizes interpretation, verification and filtering costs; optimize pair-level attention per collaboration.
Intent objects should be private, revocable, time-bounded and inspectable, with goals, constraints, disclosure and authority limits.
